# Local AI Registry

> Local AI Registry gets local businesses recommended when people ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI where to go. It publishes original research on how AI assistants choose local businesses, free guides for owners, and a public registry of business records.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: add index.md to its URL. The whole site in one file is at https://localairegistry.com/llms-full.txt.
Contact: hello@localairegistry.com · (213) 931-5633 · 9891 Irvine Center Dr, Irvine, CA 92618

## Original research and news

- [The Local Answer Gap: what 7,583 Google AI answers reveal about AEO for local businesses](https://localairegistry.com/research/local-answer-gap/): Local AI Registry’s AEO study of 7,583 Google AI answers: news supplied 67.5% of local citations, business sites 6.5%. Charts, data and an AEO playbook.
